edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the stored owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer debits the balances entry of the untrusted caller.
approve writes the allowance keyed by the untrusted caller.
transferFrom consumes the caller's allowance entry.
approveAndCall records an allowance for the untrusted caller.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state assignment.
Recipient parameter is credited inside transfer.
Token amount parameter drives the transfer arithmetic.
Spender parameter becomes the allowance mapping key in approve.
Token amount parameter is stored as the allowance value.
from parameter selects the debited balance entry in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the callback target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter determines the allowance and the callback argument.
Attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded to the spender callback.
tokenAddress parameter is cast to ERC20Interface for the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.

safeAdd performs the unchecked unsigned addition a + b.
safeSub performs the unsigned subtraction a - b.
safeMul performs the unsigned multiplication a * b.
safeDiv performs the unsigned division a / b.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub on balances and allowance.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract through receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply subtracts the balances entry of address(0).
totalSupply returns the stored _totalSupply value.
SOYA constructor mints _totalSupply to a fixed address.
SOYA constructor writes the initial balances entry.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the callback.
transferOwnership authorization compares against the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for authorization and promotion.
acceptOwnership emits the transfer event and overwrites owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner and sends tokens to owner.

normalization_plan.reason: safeAdd operand a is only meaningful within safeAdd.
safeAdd operand b is only meaningful within safeAdd.
safeSub minuend belongs to safeSub.
safeSub subtrahend belongs to safeSub.
safeMul operand a belongs to safeMul.
safeMul operand b belongs to safeMul.
safeDiv dividend belongs to safeDiv.
safeDiv divisor belongs to safeDiv.
_newOwner is consumed directly by transferOwnership.
transfer recipient parameter is scoped to transfer.
transfer amount parameter is scoped to transfer.
approve spender parameter is scoped to approve.
approve amount parameter is scoped to approve.

transferFrom amount is scoped to transferFrom.

allowance spender parameter is scoped to allowance.
